messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert — Incident 6821 for tenant "Argonaut" on dedicated pool dp-32. Elevated 5xx rate (x10) over last 5m. Paging #incidents and @oncall_ryan. Metric snapshot: errors_per_min=120 -> baseline=12. Impact: API latency + failures for customer-critical endpoints.

oncall_ryan: Ack. Investigating GPU memory and model errors. Pulling dp-32 shard logs.

oncall_ryan: Triage: nodes serving model_v4_base_q4 showing GPU mem ~98%, repeated OOMs and GC stall. KV cache churn, readiness flips -> controller restarts causing request retries.

olivia_eng: Argonaut is tenant-pinned to model_v4_base_q4. Recommend tenant-scoped fallback to a lower-memory safe variant rather than evicting tenant or draining the pool.

lexi_support: Customer impact from Argonaut: "Autocomplete times out; search returns 500s; checkout occasionally fails." They've marked P1 and asking for ETA.

jordan_reliability: Proposed live mitigation:
1) Apply tenant override -> hosted-v3-stable (safe, smaller footprint).
2) Set override TTL 60m, monitor metrics.
3) If stable, extend and schedule a maintenance for root cause.

Command:
```
redwoodctl tenant-override set --tenant argonaut --model hosted-v3-stable --scope tenant --duration 60m --reason "dp-32 mem saturation: live migrate to safe variant"
```

oncall_ryan: Applying now.

oncall_ryan: OK: override active for tenant=argonaut; model=hosted-v3-stable; expires=2027-09-02T15:22:34Z

incident-bot: Change logged chg_0x9b3a. Notifying routing and metrics.

monitoring-bot: Metrics after override (3m): errors_per_min 120 -> 16; p50 latency 220ms -> 125ms; p95 1.8s -> 0.95s.

customer_ops_ellie: Notified Argonaut: "Temporary override applied to stable fallback to reduce errors; monitoring in progress. Next update 15m." Customer replied with :thumbsup:.

maria_product: For postmortem: capture decision criteria for live-migrate vs eviction, tenant pinning policy, and customer comms template. Assign eng-ml + customer-success.

jordan_reliability: Will extend override to 4h if metrics hold for next 10m. Also automating alert: auto-apply hosted fallback if DP GPU mem >95% for 2m. Collecting KV cache heatmaps and dp-32 logs.

oncall_ryan: Incident mitigated for now; pager remains open for confirmation. Adding runbook task: create canary rollback steps and automation for tenant-safe fallback triggers.

incident-bot: Status -> mitigated (monitoring improving). Incident lead: oncall_ryan. Follow-ups: postmortem + runbook.
note: No title field per Slack thread schema.
